title: Trim whitespace in MCP tool name lookup to handle Kimi K2.5 formatting quirk
description:
Kimi K2.5 (`moonshotai/kimi-k2.5`) systematically emits tool names with leading whitespace, e.g. `"  pass_priority"` or `"                         choose_action"` (26 leading spaces). The MCP tool registry does an exact HashMap lookup, so these all fail with `Unknown tool`.

This happened 7 times in a single game, each wasting a round-trip and tokens.

Evidence:
- ~/.mage-bench/logs/game_20260228_010846_g4/Kimi25 Philo_errors.log: 7 occurrences
- McpToolRegistry.java:88-91 — `byName.get(name)` with no trimming
- McpServer.java:207-208 — `params.get("name").getAsString()` with no trimming

Fix: Add `name = name.strip()` in `McpToolRegistry.call()` before the HashMap lookup. This is a one-line defensive fix that helps any model with whitespace formatting issues.

Alternatively, log a warning when trimming changes the name so we can track which models have this issue.
